name: Play Group
headline: Where learning meets fun and friendship
summary: A joyful first step into learning: discovering the world, making friends and building social skills.
paragraphs: Play Group is one of the most delightful ways for your child to begin a journey of discovery. It is a place to learn about the world, make friends and practise essential social skills, and an enriching experience for parents, grandparents and caregivers too.

Our Play Group sessions support physical development, encourage problem-solving, build communication and nurture positive social interaction, with every moment full of joy. Our qualified staff create a safe space where children aged two and above explore, learn and play together.
photoAlt: Colourful indoor play area with rockers and a slide at a Crossmaze centre

name: Nursery
headline: Where comfort and confidence flourish
summary: A second home where children build self-esteem, friendships and their first academic foundations.
paragraphs: For many children, Nursery is their first time away from their parents, so we have made it a second home, full of materials that delight, comfort and reassure them.

Here children discover who they are and build self-esteem: they learn the importance of their own name, the value of their belongings and the joy of friendship. The program weaves early academic foundations together with creativity and thematic exploration, setting the stage for success later on. A strong start leads to a strong finish.
photoAlt: Children in Crossmaze uniforms working together at a classroom table

name: Junior KG
headline: Nurturing all-round development
summary: Numeracy, literacy, fine motor skills, logical thinking and problem-solving, learnt together.
paragraphs: Junior KG is a pivotal year in which we nurture every side of a child’s development. Our curriculum focuses on the key areas that lay the foundation for a bright future: numeracy, literacy, fine motor skills, logical thinking and problem-solving.

At this age children are refining their language and thinking skills, are eager to explore new languages and are developing a keen sense of numbers. Through engaging group activities, our teachers encourage teamwork, participation, sharing and taking turns.
photoAlt: A Crossmaze teacher showing a letter card to a group of children

name: Senior KG
headline: Preparing for school success
summary: A confident, smooth step into primary school, with a curriculum aligned with State, CBSE and ICSE boards.
paragraphs: Between five and six, we prepare your child for a smooth move into big school. A stimulating environment invites them to explore language, mathematics, science, physical activity, music and art, so they grow capable and confident while staying kind and caring.

Learning goes beyond reading and writing: we place a strong emphasis on thinking skills, communication and problem-solving, with extracurricular activities that let children express themselves. Our curriculum is aligned with State, CBSE and ICSE board requirements, so children join mainstream schools well prepared.
focus: Aligned with State, CBSE and ICSE boards
photoAlt: Children doing a yoga pose together in a bright Crossmaze hall

name: Day Care
headline: Day care and enrichment, where learning meets safety
summary: A nurturing, home-like full day with trained caregivers and a 1:6 adult-to-child ratio.
paragraphs: Our Day Care and Activity Centre is a special place where learning takes a fresh, playful and captivating form. Dedicated, trained caregivers keep children safe at all times, so working parents have peace of mind while they are at work.

Day care is open to Crossmaze children and to children from other schools, with a smooth move from the preschool morning into afternoon activities. Every day, we put your child’s safety, well-being and all-round development first.
